title: lycopodium cassandrae
intro: Lycopodium cassandrae, commonly known as Spiny Club Moss, is a type of lycopod fern that belongs to the Lycopodiaceae family. The plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties that may help to reduce swelling, fight free radicals, and prevent infections. The therapeutic actions of Lycopodium cassandrae include treating respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma, as well as skin conditions like eczema and acne. The bioactive constituents of the plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
